rules: Use this theme consistently across all Life Pre-Intermediate/Intermediate lessons unless a future course-level override is approved.
Use high-contrast dark-blue instructional text for projector readability.
Use accent colours for activity type, answer state and emphasis; do not make every element monochrome green.
Use the platform default Poppins font and responsive type sizing.
Answers must appear inside the relevant activity box or by highlighting the correct option, never as detached text below an activity.
